cases.sentence: (Его зовут Белтешаццар, в честь моего бога, и дух ___ пребывает в нем.)
cases.explain: «святых богов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: I saw a dream which made me afraid; and the thoughts on my bed and the visions of my head troubled me.

cases.sentence: Вот что мне приснилось, когда я лежал в своей постели: я посмотрел и увидел дерево ___, стоявшее посреди земли.
cases.explain: «огромной высоты» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Then the magicians, the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers came in; and I told the dream before them; but they didn’t make known to me its interpretation.

cases.sentence: Под ним находили пристанище полевые звери, а ___ жили на его ветвях; от него кормилось всякое живое существо.
cases.explain: «небесные птицы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “Belteshazzar, master of the magicians, because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you, and no secret troubles you, tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen, and its interpretation.

cases.sentence: Под ним находили пристанище полевые звери, а небесные птицы жили на его ветвях; от него кормилось всякое ___.
cases.explain: «живое существо» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “Belteshazzar, master of the magicians, because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you, and no secret troubles you, tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen, and its interpretation.

cases.sentence: В видениях, бывших мне, когда я лежал в постели, я видел, как ___ сошел с небес.
cases.explain: «святой страж» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Thus were the visions of my head on my bed: I saw, and behold, a tree in the middle of the earth; and its height was great.

cases.sentence: Но пень с корнями, скованный железом и бронзой, пусть останется в земле, среди ___.
cases.explain: «полевой травы» — after the preposition «среди», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The leaves of it were beautiful, and it had much fruit, and in it was food for all. The animals of the field had shade under it, and the birds of the sky lived in its branches, and all flesh was fed from it.

cases.sentence: Пусть орошает его небесная роса, пусть он живет со зверями среди ___.
cases.explain: «земных растений» — after the preposition «среди», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The leaves of it were beautiful, and it had much fruit, and in it was food for all. The animals of the field had shade under it, and the birds of the sky lived in its branches, and all flesh was fed from it.

cases.sentence: Пусть отойдет от него ___, и дастся ему разум звериный, пока не пройдет семь лет.
cases.explain: «человеческий разум» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “I saw in the visions of my head on my bed, and behold, a watcher and a holy one came down from the sky.

cases.sentence: Но ты можешь, потому что в тебе пребывает дух ___.
cases.explain: «святых богов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Nevertheless leave the stump of its roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and bronze, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of the sky. Let his portion be with the animals in the grass of the earth.

cases.sentence: Тогда Даниил (называемый также Белтешаццаром) пришел на время в крайнее замешательство и устрашился ___.
cases.explain: «собственных мыслей» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Let his heart be changed from man’s, and let an animal’s heart be given to him. Then let seven times pass over him.

cases.sentence: Ты, царь, видел ___, спускающегося с небес и говорящего: «Срубите дерево и погубите его, но оставьте пень, сковав его железом и бронзой, среди полевой травы, и корни его пусть останутся в земле.
cases.explain: «святого стража» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The tree that you saw, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached to the sky, and its sight to all the earth;

cases.sentence: Ты, царь, видел святого стража, спускающегося с небес и говорящего: «Срубите дерево и погубите его, но оставьте пень, сковав его железом и бронзой, среди ___, и корни его пусть останутся в земле.
cases.explain: «полевой травы» — after the preposition «среди», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The tree that you saw, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached to the sky, and its sight to all the earth;

cases.sentence: Пусть его орошает небесная роса; пусть он живет, как ___, пока не пройдет семь лет».
cases.explain: «дикие звери» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The tree that you saw, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached to the sky, and its sight to all the earth;

cases.sentence: Вот толкование, о царь, и вот решение Всевышнего против моего господина царя: 22 тебя прогонят от людей, и ты будешь жить с ___.
cases.explain: «дикими зверями» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: whose leaves were beautiful, and its fruit plentiful, and in it was food for all; under which the animals of the field lived, and on whose branches the birds of the sky had their habitation:

cases.sentence: Двенадцать месяцев спустя, когда царь гулял по крыше ___ в Вавилоне, 27 он сказал:
cases.explain: «царского дворца» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Whereas they commanded to leave the stump of the roots of the tree; your kingdom shall be sure to you, after that you will have known that the heavens do rule.

cases.sentence: Тебя прогонят от людей, и ты будешь жить с ___ и есть траву, подобно волу.
cases.explain: «дикими зверями» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: At the end of twelve months he was walking in the royal palace of Babylon.

cases.sentence: Его тело омывалось небесной росой до тех пор, пока его волосы не выросли длинными, как перья орла, а ногти не стали точно ___.
cases.explain: «птичьи когти» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The king spoke and said, “Is not this great Babylon, which I have built for the royal dwelling place, by the might of my power and for the glory of my majesty?”

cases.sentence: В то же время, когда вернулся ко мне мой разум, ко мне вернулись и ___, и честь, и величие.
cases.explain: «царская слава» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: This was fulfilled the same hour on Nebuchadnezzar. He was driven from men, and ate grass as oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of the sky, until his hair had grown like eagles’ feathers, and his nails like birds’ claws.
